expectedMemories.title: Use sqlite-vec for dense retrieval
expectedMemories.description: Termyte vector search must use sqlite-vec native tables instead of scanning embedding BLOBs.

queries.query: How should vector search work?

expectedMemories.title: Keep SQLite migrations idempotent
expectedMemories.description: Schema updates must use CREATE IF NOT EXISTS and add-column guards so existing databases migrate safely.

queries.query: How should storage migrations be written?

trace.user_prompt: Embedding provider timed out during observation indexing.

expectedObservations.title: failed embedding retry
expectedObservations.description: Embedding failures must retry through jobs.

expectedMemories.title: Retry embedding failures through durable jobs
expectedMemories.description: When embedding generation times out, keep the observation pending and retry the embed job instead of marking it indexed.

queries.query: What happens if embedding generation times out?

expectedObservations.title: memory supersession
expectedObservations.description: Newer memory supersedes old vector scan guidance.

expectedMemories.title: Supersede BLOB vector scan guidance
expectedMemories.description: The old in-memory BLOB scan approach is deprecated and superseded by sqlite-vec indexing.

queries.query: Which vector scan approach is deprecated?

expectedMemories.title: Use .js extensions in TypeScript imports
expectedMemories.description: Because the project uses NodeNext module resolution, TypeScript source imports must include .js extensions.

queries.query: What import extension convention is required?

expectedMemories.title: Store owns SQLite CRUD boundaries
expectedMemories.description: src/storage/store.ts remains the CRUD boundary for traces, observations, memories, sessions, and summaries.

queries.query: Which file owns SQLite CRUD for memories?

expectedMemories.title: Preserve local-first retrieval infrastructure
expectedMemories.description: Termyte should not depend on Chroma, Redis, Postgres, Qdrant, LanceDB, or any external vector database.

queries.query: Can Termyte use an external vector database?

expectedObservations.title: project architecture decision
expectedObservations.description: All ingestion paths use the same durable queue.

expectedMemories.title: Use one durable pipeline for synth and worker
expectedMemories.description: Both synth and worker entry points must enqueue the same job sequence so the corpus does not fracture.

queries.query: How should synth and worker ingestion relate?

expectedMemories.title: Do not swallow embedding failures
expectedMemories.description: Embedding persistence must be a durable job stage, not a fire-and-forget side effect with swallowed errors.

queries.query: Why are fire-and-forget embeddings unsafe?

expectedMemories.title: Eval harness uses deterministic corpus
expectedMemories.description: The eval command should run against fixed local fixtures and deterministic mock embeddings without network access.

queries.query: What does the eval harness run against?

expectedObservations.title: context feedback loop
expectedObservations.description: Shown and used feedback are separate events.

expectedMemories.title: Separate shown feedback from used feedback
expectedMemories.description: Context injection records shown feedback, but used feedback is recorded only when the downstream client explicitly reports use.

queries.query: When should used feedback be recorded?

expectedMemories.title: Expose exhausted jobs as dead letters
expectedMemories.description: Jobs that exhaust retry attempts must move to dead state with a readable last_error for diagnostics.

queries.query: How do exhausted jobs become visible?

expectedMemories.title: Recover expired job leases
expectedMemories.description: A leased job whose lease_until is in the past must return to a claimable failed state so another worker can continue.

queries.query: What happens when a worker lease expires?

expectedMemories.title: Use deterministic token-budget packing
expectedMemories.description: Retrieved context should be packed within a fixed token budget using deterministic scoring and provenance-preserving trimming.

queries.query: How should retrieved context fit the model window?

expectedMemories.title: Use FTS5 BM25 for sparse retrieval
expectedMemories.description: Sparse keyword lookup should use SQLite FTS5 with BM25 ranking before hybrid fusion.

queries.query: Which sparse keyword search should Termyte use?

expectedMemories.title: Fuse dense and sparse hits with RRF
expectedMemories.description: Hybrid retrieval should combine dense sqlite-vec hits and sparse BM25 hits using Reciprocal Rank Fusion with k around 60.

queries.query: How are dense and sparse retrieval results fused?

expectedMemories.title: Score memory decay with time and access frequency
expectedMemories.description: Memory decay score should combine freshness, recent access, importance, confidence, and bounded usage count.

queries.query: What signals determine memory decay?

expectedMemories.title: Represent contradictions as memory edges
expectedMemories.description: Conflicting memories should be marked conflicted and linked with a contradicts edge rather than silently deleting either side.

queries.query: How are contradictory memories represented?

expectedMemories.title: Viewer shows queue and dead-letter health
expectedMemories.description: The local diagnostics viewer should expose pending, leased, failed, and dead jobs so pipeline failures are visible.

queries.query: What should the diagnostics viewer show?

expectedObservations.title: typed retrieval
expectedObservations.description: Users can search by document type.

expectedMemories.title: Expose typed retrieval interfaces
expectedMemories.description: CLI and MCP search must support type filters for trace, observation, memory, summary, episode, and all.

queries.query: Which retrieval type filters must CLI and MCP support?
